findings.current: The Security Team Leader contacted him personally.
findings.defect: The added object “him” implies that the Security Team Leader contacted Jin Taekyung, contradicting the reporting chain and the following explanation.
findings.rationale: Team Leader 1 is recounting the Security Team Leader’s direct report to him; the source does not say that the target was contacted.
findings.replacement: The Security Team Leader contacted me directly.

findings.current: Im Chunsoo raised a hand to stop him.
findings.defect: The draft changes the explicitly named subject from Im Changsoo to Im Chunsoo.
findings.rationale: The source names 임창수, whose binding rendering is Im Changsoo.
findings.replacement: Im Changsoo raised a hand to stop him.
findings.source: 임창수가 손을 들어 그를 제지했기 때문이었다.

findings.current: Im Chunsoo went ahead, and I followed behind him.
findings.defect: The draft again substitutes Im Chunsoo for the source’s explicitly named Im Changsoo.
findings.rationale: The source names 임창수, and the glossary requires Im Changsoo.
findings.replacement: Im Changsoo went ahead, and I followed behind him.
findings.source: 임창수가 앞장섰고 내가 그 뒤를 따랐다.

findings.current: With my clear voice, the mana suffused throughout the air began to churn.
findings.defect: The draft identifies Taekyung as the speaker even though the source deliberately leaves the voice’s owner unstated before Kim Hwajong’s reveal.
findings.rationale: The Korean says only that a clear voice is heard; adding “my” reverses the intended concealed intervention.
findings.replacement: At the sound of a clear voice, the mana permeating the air began to churn.
findings.source: 또렷한 음성과 함께 대기에 스며든 마나가 요동친다.

findings.current: The frost-covered ground melted beneath Im Chunsoo’s magic, and flames surged upward.
findings.defect: The draft makes Im Chunsoo’s magic cause the melting and flames instead of identifying his magic as the cause of the preexisting frost.
findings.rationale: The source modifies the frosted ground with “by Im Chunsoo’s magic”; the Fire Wall, cast by the still-unrevealed intervening mage, melts that frost.
findings.replacement: The ground, which had been frosted over by Im Chunsoo’s magic, melted as flames surged upward.
findings.source: 임춘수의 마법으로 서리가 끼어 있던 바닥이 녹고 불꽃이 솟구쳤다.

findings.current: More than a dozen ice spikes formed in the empty air above my head.
findings.defect: The draft changes the stated quantity from roughly ten or a dozen to more than twelve.
findings.rationale: 십여 개 means approximately ten, naturally rendered here as “around a dozen,” not “more than a dozen.”
findings.replacement: Around a dozen ice spikes formed in the empty air above my head.
findings.source: 아무것도 없던 머리 위 허공에서 십여 개의 얼음송곳이 생겨났다.

findings.current: My people made a mistake because they were impatient. Will you understand?
findings.defect: The literal question is unnatural and misses the pragmatic request that Taekyung overlook or forgive the incident.
findings.rationale: 이해해 줄 텐가 asks for leniency in context rather than merely checking whether Taekyung comprehends the explanation.
findings.replacement: My people got impatient and made a mistake. Can you let it slide?
findings.source: 우리 애들이 조급함에 실수를 저질렀네. 이해해 줄 텐가?

findings.current: From the Guild Master’s perspective—and from the Guild’s perspective as a whole—there could hardly be a greater humiliation.
findings.defect: The draft sanitizes the narrator’s vulgar intensifier and shifts his conversational voice into formal prose.
findings.rationale: 개망신 is strongly vulgar and emphatic here; Taekyung’s narration should retain that register.
findings.replacement: For the Guild Master—and the Guild as a whole—this was about as fucking humiliating as it got.
findings.source: 길드장은 물론이고 길드 전체 입장에서 봐도 이런 개망신이 또 없다.

findings.current: You look so miserable that even an idiot could tell.
findings.defect: The draft adds an insult to the observer that is absent from the rhetorical Korean.
findings.rationale: 누가 모르나 means that the expression makes the problem obvious to anyone; it does not call anyone an idiot.
findings.replacement: With a long face like that, anyone could tell.
findings.source: 앞으로는 들어오기 전에 거울 보고 와. 그렇게 죽상을 하고 있는데 누가 모르나.

findings.defect: The draft adds profanity to a shocked exclamation that contains none.
findings.rationale: 이게 무슨 expresses startled disbelief without the stronger register introduced by “the hell.”

findings.current: “Damn. We really got played. How does a Guild with only five people have so much to hide?”
findings.defect: The grunt 끙 is replaced with explicit profanity.
findings.rationale: 끙 is a frustrated groan rather than a curse.
findings.replacement: “Ugh, we really got played. How does a Guild with only five people have so much to hide?”
findings.source: “끙, 이거 아주 제대로 당했네. 달랑 다섯 명 있는 길드가 뭐 이리 숨기는 게 많아?”

findings.current: There was no misunderstanding that needed clearing up, but I had no idea what would happen if I said, *No, thank you.*
findings.defect: “No, thank you” makes Taekyung’s imagined refusal more gracious and indirect than the blunt source.
findings.rationale: 싫어요 is a direct refusal—literally that he does not want to—not an expression of thanks.
findings.replacement: There was no misunderstanding that needed clearing up, but I had no idea what would happen if I said, *No.*
findings.source: 굳이 오해를 풀 만한 일은 없지만 ‘싫어요.’라고 했을 경우 무슨 일이 벌어질지 모르겠다.

findings.current: The ball had gone well past the hole and only stopped after striking Team Leader 1’s shoe.
findings.defect: “Past the hole” specifies that the ball overshot it, while the source only says that it went far wide of the hole.
findings.rationale: 벗어난 describes deviation from the hole without establishing that the ball traveled beyond it.
findings.replacement: The ball had rolled far wide of the hole and only stopped after striking Team Leader 1’s shoe.
findings.source: 홀(Hole)을 한참이나 벗어난 공은 1팀장의 신발에 부딪힌 후에야 멈췄다.

findings.current: “Team Leader 3. He’s been bragging that he’ll bring back some famous tea after his business trip to China.”
findings.defect: The draft says he will obtain the tea after the trip rather than while in China on the trip.
findings.rationale: 중국 출장 가서 means that he intends to obtain the tea during the business trip and bring it back.
findings.replacement: “Team Leader 3. He’s been bragging that he’ll bring back some famous tea from his upcoming business trip to China.”
findings.source: “3팀장이죠. 이번에 중국 출장 가서 명차를 구해 오겠다고 호언장담을 하고 다닙니다.”

findings.current: Once I form a relationship of enmity with someone, I have to see it through to the end.
findings.defect: “Form a relationship of enmity” is an unnatural Korean-syntax calque in otherwise direct dialogue.
findings.rationale: 원한 관계 refers naturally to having a grudge or feud with someone.
findings.replacement: Once I have a grudge against someone, I have to see it through to the end.
findings.source: 난 일단 원한 관계가 맺어지면 무조건 끝을 봐야 해.

findings.current: Frozen. The seasoned A-rank mage who had fought his way through the Great Cataclysm with his entire body.
findings.defect: “With his entire body” is an awkward literal calque that does not convey firsthand endurance naturally in English.
findings.rationale: 온몸으로 emphasizes that he personally endured and fought through the catastrophe, not that he used his whole body as a distinct mechanism.
findings.replacement: Frozen. The seasoned A-rank mage who had fought his way through the Great Cataclysm himself.
findings.source: 프로즌. 대격변을 온몸으로 헤쳐 나간 노련한 A급 마법사가 나를 향해 손을 펼친 순간.

summary: The draft contains critical subject, identity, magical-mechanism, and quantity errors, along with several register shifts and localized natural-English issues.
